data.name: SqlTimeZoneUnknown
data.value: {0} '{1}' is not a time zone this deployment recognizes. Enter UTC, or an IANA time zone name such as Europe/London or America/New_York.

data.name: SqlDocUnrecognisedField
data.value: {0} has an unrecognized field '{1}'.{2} Fields that are not recognized are refused rather than ignored, because ignoring one would leave the Connected System configured differently from how the document reads.

data.name: SqlDocDeltaNeedsChangeLog
data.value: {0} is '{1}', but Object Type '{2}' is selected for synchronization and has no 'changeLog'. A Delta Import that skipped an object type would report success while leaving its objects to drift, so every selected object type needs one. Give it a 'changeLog', or deselect it if JIM never imports from it.

data.name: SqlDocDeltaNeedsWatermark
data.value: {0} is '{1}', but Object Type '{2}' is selected for synchronization and has no 'watermarkColumn'. A Delta Import that skipped an object type would report success while leaving its objects to drift, so every selected object type needs one. Give it a 'watermarkColumn', or deselect it if JIM never imports from it.

data.name: SqlDocColumnReferenceUnknown
data.value: Object Type '{0}' says column '{1}' references object type '{2}', which this document does not declare. A reference can only point at an object type JIM also synchronizes.

data.name: PfSetByHand
data.value: Set the password requirements on the Synchronization Rule to match the target's policy by hand, and expect a rejection to be how a mismatch shows up.

data.name: PfGraphNoRole
data.value: The app holds the permission, but its token shows no directory role that resets passwords. Graph also needs the app to hold User Administrator across the tenant: run Register-JIMEntraIdConnector -PasswordManagement, or assign it in the Entra admin center. A role assigned in the last hour can be missing from the token until it is renewed.
